platform: Windows x64, Ubuntu 24.04 WSL2 for Linux tools
path_normalization: Staging root is replaced by <corpus>, workspace root by <workspace>, user home by <user-home>; interpreter paths use named placeholders. Paths within commands are normalized to POSIX separators. File bytes are unmodified.

commands.label: availability only: Windows registry utility
commands.stdout:
REG Operation [Parameter List]



  Operation  [ QUERY   | ADD    | DELETE  | COPY    |

               SAVE    | LOAD   | UNLOAD  | RESTORE |

               COMPARE | EXPORT | IMPORT  | FLAGS ]



Return Code: (Except for REG COMPARE)



  0 - Successful

  1 - Failed



For help on a specific operation type:



  REG Operation /?



Examples:



  REG QUERY /?

  REG ADD /?

  REG DELETE /?

  REG COPY /?

  REG SAVE /?

  REG RESTORE /?

  REG LOAD /?

  REG UNLOAD /?

  REG COMPARE /?

  REG EXPORT /?

  REG IMPORT /?

  REG FLAGS /?

blockers: Importazione nativa richiede un hive Windows usa e getta; nessuna modifica al registro corrente eseguita.
